source_reference: UI-15 Show/Copy/Save, area-crop Editor/Thumbnail and preview-close affordances; post-capture public exports
fixture: Synthetic captured image with area-crop and preview options plus an explicit close/cancel path.
trigger: Plan and run post-capture steps through planPostCaptureSteps and runPostCapturePlan.
target_observation_needed: Record which options combine, action order and when each action fires or cancels.
ferby_observation_needed: Record planned steps, token/result behavior and handler invocation order.
acceptance_rule: Compare ordering, cancellation and output only after recording target behavior.
limitations: The public planner API does not prove UI wiring or actual image/show/save effects.

source_reference: UI-02/UI-03 Copy Image, Save Image, Save Image As, Print and drag-and-drop labels
fixture: Synthetic output document and injectable step handlers for copy, save, print and drag destinations.
trigger: Run a plan containing each output operation, including handler failure and cancellation.
target_observation_needed: Record clipboard types, print output and drag destination formats/errors.
ferby_observation_needed: Record PostCaptureStep sequence, handler results and failure propagation.
acceptance_rule: Compare step ordering, formats and errors only with separately recorded target results.
limitations: The named API plans generic steps; it does not prove native clipboard, print or drag implementations.

source_reference: UI-15 Screenshots folder, Auto/PNG/JPEG and Retina-to-1x save labels; post-capture preferences exports
fixture: Synthetic preferences with Auto, PNG and JPEG choices, folder boundary and Retina dimensions.
trigger: Clone defaults, create a token and plan save steps for each preference variant.
target_observation_needed: Record format decision, filename, quality, folder behavior and scaling rules.
ferby_observation_needed: Record clonePostCapturePreferences, createPostCaptureToken and planned preference steps.
acceptance_rule: Compare preferences and scaling only after target and Ferby observations are captured.
limitations: The public exports do not establish filesystem writes, filename policy, encoder quality or Retina scaling.
